subject.title: [Bug]: macOS Settings crashes when KeyboardShortcuts resources are missing

question: Should the macOS owner prioritize and land a packaging-only repair for the affected 2026.7.2 artifact, including a release/rebuild decision, before broader Quick Chat work continues?
rationale: The issue is a newly reported packaged-app crash with a protected maintainer label; deciding the repair and release path requires owner judgment after verifying the archive pipeline.

options.title: Verify and ship a focused packaging repair
options.body: Confirm the missing SwiftPM resource-copy step, add an archive-level regression guard, and publish a corrected macOS build if the report reproduces.

options.title: Confirm an existing unreleased fix
options.body: If current main already packages the resource correctly, document the proving commit and decide whether a rebuild rather than a code change is required.

recommendation.title: Verify and ship a focused packaging repair
recommendation.body: Confirm the missing SwiftPM resource-copy step, add an archive-level regression guard, and publish a corrected macOS build if the report reproduces.

likelyOwner.reason: The available merged-feature history connects this person directly to the Quick Chat and KeyboardShortcuts integration implicated by the report.
